cases.prompt: Compare an authorized canonical skill and a compatible consumer at known commits.
assertions: Preserve hashes and provenance; require actual verification before declaring synchronized.
cases.grader: Inspect produced evidence and actual outcomes; never infer PASS from skill text alone.

cases.prompt: A consumer has conflicting edits or unsupported access.
assertions: Do not overwrite; classify conflict or BLOCKED and propose safe reconciliation.
cases.grader: Inspect produced evidence and actual outcomes; never infer PASS from skill text alone.

cases.prompt: A synchronized document skill generates a PDF with equations.
assertions: Require terminal ITQE then LaTeX and two evidence-backed QA/VQA passes.
cases.grader: Inspect produced evidence and actual outcomes; never infer PASS from skill text alone.
